scenarios.name: update-not-on-file-short-commarea
scenarios.why: the caller passed 90 bytes and customer 99 is not on file: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE's IF EIBCALEN > 0 and IF EIBCALEN < 91 true: MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CA-DATA, then the LINK with CA-ERROR-MSG

notes: GenApp's VSAM 'update customer' (LGUCVS01, LINKed by LGUCDB01): EXEC CICS READ FILE('KSDSCUST') INTO(WS-Customer-Area) LENGTH(WS-Commarea-Len = EIBCALEN) RIDFLD(CA-CUSTOMER-NUM) KEYLENGTH(10) UPDATE, then REWRITE FROM(CA-CUSTOMER-NUM) LENGTH(225). Each scenario's KSDSCUST is compared after the task. Every non-NORMAL RESP in this program goes to WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, whose first act is EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('LGSTSQ') (GenApp's TS/TD error logger). The harness runs one program, but the case's programs list adds LGSTSQ to the same task (X6, #4607), so the error paths run: NOTFND and IOERR on the READ UPDATE ('81', ABEND LGV1), IOERR and NOSPACE on the REWRITE ('82', ABEND LGV2). A task that reaches WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE runs on through LGSTSQ: LGSTSQ writes EIBCALEN + 5 bytes from its 95-byte WRITE-MSG, which is past FROM, and the stand-in and the det port write FROM's bytes then spaces to LENGTH on both sides (X6, ASSUMED, owner 2026-10-21; IBM writes the storage after FROM, undefined), so the logged records and the end state are compared. WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE then copies the COMMAREA into CA-DATA and LINKs LGSTSQ again with the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG: IF EIBCALEN < 91 true (a short-COMMAREA scenario, 90 bytes) and false (the full COMMAREA) are both judged. IF EIBCALEN > 0 false needs a call with no COMMAREA, which reads LINKAGE past EIBCALEN 0 (X23-class) and the two sides do not agree on, so no scenario states it. The faults list injects the file RESPs a healthy data set cannot give (IOERR, NOSPACE); the region ASSIGN SYSID is a deployment fact the corpus does not name. The READ's LENGTH is modelled on both sides (#4436, oracle_assumptions.md X14): WS-Commarea-Len (S9(4) COMP) is MOVEd from EIBCALEN (32500 here), so the LENGTH CICS gets differs from the 1024-byte INTO area; the 225-byte record is shorter than both (NORMAL), and LENGTH is set back to 225. A shorter LENGTH would truncate with LENGERR -- on READ UPDATE refused by name, and its path LINKs LGSTSQ anyway. Keys: PIC 9(10), digits only; no browse. Data: ksdscust.txt as in genapp-lgacvs01 (GenApp's db2cre.jcl sample customers).
